name: Domaine de Marie
kicker: Pink convent church on Ngo Quyen
summary: Walk the convent garden and look up at the pink church of Domaine de Marie, at 1 Ngo Quyen on the west ridge. It is a quiet stop on the French hill-station loop, and twenty to thirty minutes covers the front and the garden.
heroCaption: The courtyard at Domaine de Marie

notice.title: Not the Chicken Church
notice.body: The rooster tower is Da Lat Cathedral on Tran Phu. Domaine de Marie is the convent church at 1 Ngo Quyen.

body: The pink church and the convent garden are at 1 Ngo Quyen. Twenty to thirty minutes covers the front and the garden.
Pair it with the cathedral on Tran Phu, the church with the rooster on its tower, if churches are your interest. Entry is free.

figures.caption: The convent courtyard and pink church
figures.alt: Courtyard and pink church at Domaine de Marie in Da Lat

gettingThere: The church is at 1 Ngo Quyen, on the west ridge. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake.
admissionNote: Free (Visit Lâm Đồng). Hours are Check on arrival.
